press_references.value: DoubleZero rolls out Edge, a low-latency onchain data delivery service on its global fiber DePIN infrastructure

product_launches.description: DoubleZero launched the public beta of DoubleZero Edge, a permissionless low-latency onchain market data delivery service running on its global fiber DePIN network, initially providing real-time Solana block data and involving major Solana infrastructure providers.

press_references.value: DoubleZero protocol launches mainnet-beta for dedicated crypto communication

product_launches.description: DoubleZero launched its mainnet-beta, a dedicated high-speed DePIN network with 70+ direct fiber links across 25 locations to lower latency for blockchain traffic.

press_references.value: ‘Crypto’s Flash Boys’: A Q&A With Austin Federa on DoubleZero
press_references.publisher: CoinDesk: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Crypto News and Price Data

product_launches.description: Austin Federa says DoubleZero will launch its high-performance blockchain networking protocol on mainnet in September 2025, alongside a token launch; its testnet already carries stake from 12.57% of SOL and plans to scale from 8 to 50+ fiber links with 10–200 Gbit capacity.
